willDo: Once the presentation concludes, we will start with the

We will come out with the next phase for Tech Mahindra as we close this phase that we talked about, which is by end of FY27 we get to 15% EBIT margin and then we talk about the next phase as we go from there.
strengths: On the Farm equipment side, we had an 18% volume growth, a very strong market share.
weaknesses: And if I just look at last Q1 versus this Q1, GS2 which is 30+, early risk, that's 100 bps lower than last Q1.
opportunities: Tech Mahindra driven by margin expansion, EBIT margins up to 14.4% and the promise has been to get to 15% by the end of this fiscal year.
threats: Binay: And secondly, when I add up the comments, we are talking about 450 basis point of commodity headwind in Q1, we are saying that we've taken 2.7% price hike and yet margin will be neutral-ish, which means almost…
So, we kind of took a conscious call that let's not kind of keep doing this incrementally with all the uncertainty and we took a conscious call to do a 2.7% average increase.
But strong performance in quarter one, despite the headwinds that we've had because of the war and commodity prices.
